svg.title: Accuracy against speed for six search methods on two benchmarks
svg.desc: Two panels, SIFT and GloVe. Recall at 10 on the horizontal axis, queries per second on a logarithmic vertical axis. The four conventional methods sit two to three orders of magnitude above FlyHash at every accuracy; DenseFly's line stops at 0.525 (SIFT) and 0.420 (GloVe).
